messages:
Nina - Recruiting: Heads-up: Marta Lopezs onsite is tentatively set for Tue 9/14, 09:30-13:30 PT. Candidate is flying in and arrives the morning of.
Carlos - Eng Manager: Thanks. Whos confirmed on the loop?
Nina - Recruiting: 09:30-10:00 intro + culture with me, 10:10-11:00 system design with Carlos, 11:15-11:45 take-home walkthrough with Leah, 12:00-12:30 hiring manager + comp chat, 12:30-13:30 lunch debrief (onsite).
Leah - SWE: FYI Im remote that day. Can we have a Zoom room for the take-home?
Nina - Recruiting: Yes, Zoom in the invites. Also reserving Conf D for the interviewers who are onsite.
Tom - People Ops: Travel/process note: we cover economy train/flight + ground transportation up to $150 for domestic same-day travel. Marta was sent the travel reimbursement form and a prepaid parking voucher option. Link: https://redwoodinference.com/travel-reimburse
Nina - Recruiting: Marta asked about childcare break during the loop. Can we allow a 20-minute pause after the take-home?
Carlos - Eng Manager: That's fine; the schedule can shift 20 mins. We have flexibility on the lunch slot.
Leah - SWE: I can push my slot by 20 if needed.
security-bot: Visitor badge created: Marta Lopez, VIS-9054. Badge pickup: Main Lobby. Escort required Y/N: No (escort offered).
Nina - Recruiting: Marta requested a quiet room to review notes 09:00-09:25. Can we reserve?
Tom - People Ops: Reserved Quiet Room 2 from 08:50-09:30. Added to calendar.
reception-bot: Reception notified to greet Marta at 09:20 and provide welcome packet.
Nina - Recruiting: Marta also said she has a mobility scooter and will need elevator assistance; facilities informed.
Tom - People Ops: Facilities confirmed elevator access and will prep a ground-floor pickup point at the main entrance.
Carlos - Eng Manager: Good to know. Also, is Marta comfortable with whiteboard? I can do a digital whiteboard share if needed.
Leah - SWE: I've updated the take-home rubric and uploaded to /docs/interviews/2026/takehome-marta-rubric.pdf. Focus: correctness, system tradeoffs, clarity.
Nina - Recruiting: Candidate dietary note: pescatarian. Lunch will have fish option and a vegetarian side.
Carlos - Eng Manager: Parking: do we validate? I can drop Marta a voucher code.
Tom - People Ops: We will validate up to $25 or provide ride credit. Please ask candidate preference; travel form captures that.
Nina - Recruiting: Quick timezone math: candidate is PST, so times are local for them.
Leah - SWE: I'll test Zoom + whiteboard 10 min early.
Carlos - Eng Manager: I'll be onsite and can help with A/V.
Nina - Recruiting: Also, Marta asked whether she could have a brief thank-you note after the loop and when she should expect feedback. We typically share next steps within 72 hours. Is that still fine?
Tom - People Ops: Standard process: feedback due 48 hours from interviewers, recruiter follow-up within 72 hours with next steps. I'll trigger Greenhouse reminders.
Nina - Recruiting: Update: Marta preferred a 10:00 start to avoid morning transit delays. She asked if we can move start by 30 mins.
Carlos - Eng Manager: OK to move to 10:00. Please update invites.
Leah - SWE: Works for me.
Nina - Recruiting: Calendar updated to 10:00-14:00 PT to allow extra buffer. Zoom + rooms attached.https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=def456
reception-bot: Catering request submitted: 4 lunches, 1 pescatarian, 1 vegetarian.
Nina - Recruiting: Marta also asked about parental leave policy question during comp chat. Can someone from People Ops join or is it okay to answer high-level?
Tom - People Ops: I can join the 12:00 comp chat for 15 minutes to cover policy details and benefits overview.
Carlos - Eng Manager: Great. Also reminder: post-interview please file feedback in Greenhouse and mark any accommodations that were used.
Nina - Recruiting: Final note  we will ask Marta to bring ID for badge. I'll DM her the building map and public transit options.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Marta Lopez  Onsite Loop"  invites pushed with rooms, Zoom, and accessibility notes.
Nina - Recruiting: Thanks team. Morning-of I'll post exact Zoom passcode and reception desk number. :raised_hands:
